div.head: Ine 23.2
div.ab: Gif hit ðonne abbud sy oððe abbudisse, dælon on ða ilcan wisan wið ðone cyning.
Gif hit ðonne abbod sie oððe abbodesse, dælen on þa ilcan wisan wið þone kyning.
Si autem abbas uel abbatissa intersit, diuidant eodem modo cum rege.
Gif hit ðonne abbod sie oððe abbodesse, dælen on ða ilcan wisan wið þone kyning.
If, however, [his previous host] is an abbot or abbess, let the division be the same as for the king.
If, however, the person [under whose protection he has been] is an abbot or an abbess, he [or she] shall share [the wergeld] with the king in the same proportion [as the magnate does].
If, however, it is an abbot or an abbess, they are to share in the same way with the king.
Wenn es aber ein Abt oder eine Äbtissin ist, [die den Erschlagenen schützten,] so mögen sie in derselben Weise [das Wergeld für ihn] mit dem König theilen.
But if it is an abbot or an abbess [who protected the slain man], let them share [the wergeld for him] with the king in the same way.
div.note: i.e. who has previously protected the foreigner.
